name: [New❗] Impossible Squid Game! Jump Rope
desc:
Welcome to the Impossible Rope Bridge!🏆
Inspired by Squid Game Season 3!

⭐ Become a VIP or get it for FREE by waiting 20 minutes! 
⭐ PREMIUM Benefits: Chat Tag, Premium Icon and a Half the time for Lucky Block.

Show your support and love for the game by giving it a thumbs up 👍 and adding it to your favorites ⭐. Your appreciation means the world to us!
